identity.alias_note: Shared verified alias map with the ESPN DDF leg (data/inputs/player_aliases.json); suffix, punctuation and nickname spellings match through norm_player_name (FixtureIdentity). Unresolvable identities are excluded, never guessed.

inputs.per_game_note: per-game = CBS ROS total / gp (per-player games). CBS publishes nonppr totals only; half_ppr/ppr add 0.5/1.0 per reception (reception points are the only scoring difference). Arithmetic on CBS components only; no expert blending.
inputs.pies_note: Positional pies measured from the current CBS data (tier surplus). No pies file: a static file goes stale when the player pool changes.

calibration_notes: QB: bench share 0.15 below the feasible window; using 0.162 (0.0100 inside its lower edge 0.1519)
